sn47.9:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati beluvagāmake.
sn47.9:1.4: “etha tumhe bhikkhave, sāmantā vesāliyā yathāmittaṃ yathāsandiṭṭhaṃ yathāsambhattaṃ vassaṃ upetha.
sn47.9:1.6: “evaṃ bhante”ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paṭissutvā sāmantā vesāliyā yathāmittaṃ yathāsandiṭṭhaṃ yathāsambhattaṃ vassaṃ upagañchuṃ.
sn47.9:1.7: bhagavā pana tattheva beluvagāmake vassaṃ upagañchi.
sn47.9:2.1: atha kho bhagavato vassūpagatassa kharo ābādho uppajji. bāḷhā vedanā vattanti māraṇantikā.
sn47.9:2.2: tā sudaṃ bhagavā sato sampajāno adhivāsesi avihaññamāno.
sn47.9:2.4: na kho pana metaṃ patirūpaṃ yo’haṃ anāmantetvā upaṭṭhāke, anapaloketvā bhikkhusaṅghaṃ parinibbāyeyyaṃ.
sn47.9:2.5: yannūnāhaṃ imaṃ ābādhaṃ viriyena paṭippaṇāmetvā jīvitasaṅkhāraṃ adhiṭṭhāya vihareyyanti.
sn47.9:2.6: atha kho bhagavā taṃ ābādhaṃ viriyena paṭippaṇāmetvā jīvitasaṅkhāraṃ adhiṭṭhāya vihāsi.
sn47.9:3.1: atha kho bhagavā gilānā vuṭṭhito aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā vihārapacchāyāyaṃ paññatte āsane nisīdi.
sn47.9:3.2: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn47.9:3.6: api me bhante, madhurakajāto viya kāyo, disāpi me na pakkhāyanti, dhammāpi maṃ nappaṭibhanti, bhagavato gelaññena.
sn47.9:3.7: api ca me bhante, ahosi: kācideva assāsamattā
sn47.9:3.8: na tāva bhagavā parinibbāyissati. na tāva bhagavā bhikkhusaṅghaṃ ārabbha kiñcideva udāharatī”ti.
sn47.9:4.2: desito ānanda, mayā dhammo anantaraṃ abāhiraṃ katvā.
sn47.9:4.5: ahaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ pariharissāmīti vā. mamuddesiko bhikkhusaṅghoti vā so nūna ānanda, bhikkhusaṅghaṃ ārabbha kiñcideva udāhareyya.
sn47.9:4.6: tathāgatassa kho ānanda, na evaṃ hoti
sn47.9:4.7: ahaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ pariharissāmīti vā mamuddesiko bhikkhusaṅghoti vā.
sn47.9:4.8: sakiṃ ānanda, tathāgato bhikkhusaṅghaṃ ārabbha kiñcideva udāharissati:
sn47.9:4.9: etarahi kho panānanda, jiṇṇo vuddho mahallako addhagato vayo anuppatto.
sn47.9:4.12: evameva kho ānanda, veḷumissakena maññe tathāgatassa kāyo yāpeti.
sn47.9:5.1: yasmiṃ ānanda, samaye tathāgato sabbanimittānaṃ amanasikārā ekaccānaṃ vedanānaṃ nirodhā animittaṃ cetosamādhiṃ upasampajja viharati. phāsutaraṃ ānanda, tasmiṃ samaye tathāgatassa hoti.
sn47.9:5.2: tasmātihānanda, attadīpā viharatha attasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā, dhammadīpā dhammasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā.
sn47.9:6.1: kathañcānanda, bhikkhu attadīpo viharati attasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo, dhammadīpo dhammasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo:
sn47.9:6.2: idhānanda, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.9:6.5: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.9:6.6: evaṃ kho ānanda, bhikkhu attadīpo viharati attasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo, dhammadīpo dhammasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo.
sn47.9:6.7: ye hi keci ānanda, etarahi vā mamaccaye vā attadīpā viharissanti attasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā, dhammadīpā dhammasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā tamatagge me te ānanda, bhikkhū bhavissanti ye keci sikkhākāmāti.
